ecosystem.description: Usurance's own internal-role ecosystem: usurance-admin grants and revokes employee role credentials (Web2 role administration re-expressed KERI-native). Domain-independent of the us-insurance-regulation ecosystem — this document governs who holds which internal role, nothing else.

governance.transition_plan: usurance-admin is the genuine authority for Usurance-internal roles (not a bootstrap stand-in); no phase transition is expected. Key compromise/rotation is handled by KERI key state, not by document transition.

roles.description: Usurance-internal actuarial role. Placeholder persona surface — this role exists to prove multi-role coexistence, not actuarial domain function.
Usurance-internal insurance-product-design role. Placeholder persona surface — coexistence proof, not domain function.
Issuer of internal role credentials. Operates on vanilla Locksmith (pure KERI); not a persona — no onboarding block.

authorities.phase_note: Usurance's own operational admin AID (usurance-custody vault) — the genuine authority for internal roles, first production-phase authority in the framework.
